instruction:
You are a civil/coastal engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-04 sea-level-rise scenario and asset-level review package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. External climate-scenario, storm-tide, service-threshold, adaptation-option, and asset-review workflows shape the practice context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product family: `SSC-04-LH-06`
- Asset register: `ASSET-04-REGISTER-06`
- Sea-level-rise scenario table: `SLR-04-SCENARIO-06`
- Storm tide table: `STORM-04-TIDE-06`
- Service criterion: `SERVICE-04-CRITERION-06`
- Adaptation option sheet: `ADAPT-04-OPTION-06`
- Asset review memo: `MEMO-04-REVIEW-06`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Present high tide level | {{ present_high_tide_level_m }} m |
| Sea-level-rise allowance | {{ sea_level_rise_allowance_m }} m |
| Storm surge allowance | {{ storm_surge_allowance_m }} m |
| Wave allowance | {{ wave_allowance_m }} m |
| Asset elevation | {{ asset_elevation_m }} m |
| Required freeboard | {{ required_freeboard_m }} m |
| Service threshold | {{ service_threshold_m }} m |
| Adaptation budget | {{ adaptation_budget_usd }} USD |
| Selected adaptation cost | {{ selected_adaptation_cost_usd }} USD |
| Avoided damage | {{ avoided_damage_usd }} USD |
| Traced scenarios | {{ traced_scenarios }} |
| Required scenarios | {{ required_scenarios }} |

## Checks

- Future stillwater level equals present high tide plus sea-level-rise allowance plus storm surge allowance.
- Future design level equals future stillwater level plus wave allowance.
- Asset freeboard margin equals asset elevation minus future design level and required freeboard.
- Service threshold exceedance equals future stillwater level minus service threshold, clipped at zero.
- Adaptation raise required equals future design level plus required freeboard minus asset elevation, clipped at zero.
- Adaptation cost margin equals adaptation budget minus selected adaptation cost.
- Benefit-cost ratio equals avoided damage divided by selected adaptation cost.
- Scenario trace score equals traced scenarios divided by required scenarios.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when freeboard, cost, benefit-cost, and scenario trace checks pass; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact asset review memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "future_stillwater_level_m": <numeric_value>,
  "future_design_level_m": <numeric_value>,
  "asset_freeboard_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "service_threshold_exceedance_m": <numeric_value>,
  "adaptation_raise_required_m": <numeric_value>,
  "adaptation_cost_margin_usd": <numeric_value>,
  "benefit_cost_ratio": <numeric_value>,
  "scenario_trace_score": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

[meta]
name = "sea-level-rise-asset-review-package"
description = "SSC-04 sea-level-rise scenario and asset-level review metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound sea-level-rise asset review metrics from a deterministic SSC-04 task-owned source pack. The template combines future stillwater level, design level, freeboard margin, service threshold exceedance, adaptation raise, cost margin, benefit-cost ratio, scenario trace, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "civil"
category = "coastal-asset-slr-review"
standards = ["sea-level-rise scenario workflow", "coastal asset review", "adaptation option screening", "service threshold review"]
tags = ["civil", "coastal", "sea-level-rise", "asset-review", "adaptation", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.present_high_tide_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "STORM-04-TIDE-06 present high tide level"
min = 1.4
max = 1.4

[params.sea_level_rise_allowance_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SLR-04-SCENARIO-06 sea-level-rise allowance"
min = 0.65
max = 0.65

[params.storm_surge_allowance_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "STORM-04-TIDE-06 storm surge allowance"
min = 0.85
max = 0.85

[params.wave_allowance_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SLR-04-SCENARIO-06 wave allowance"
min = 0.35
max = 0.35

[params.asset_elevation_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "ASSET-04-REGISTER-06 asset elevation"
min = 3.75
max = 3.75

[params.required_freeboard_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SERVICE-04-CRITERION-06 required freeboard"
min = 0.3
max = 0.3

[params.service_threshold_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SERVICE-04-CRITERION-06 service threshold"
min = 2.7
max = 2.7

[params.adaptation_budget_usd]
type = "float"
unit = "USD"
description = "ADAPT-04-OPTION-06 adaptation budget"
min = 250000.0
max = 250000.0

[params.selected_adaptation_cost_usd]
type = "float"
unit = "USD"
description = "ADAPT-04-OPTION-06 selected adaptation cost"
min = 180000.0
max = 180000.0

[params.avoided_damage_usd]

unit = "USD"

min = 320000.0
max = 320000.0

max = 4.0

[params.required_scenarios]
type = "float"
description = "MEMO-04-REVIEW-06 required scenario count"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[outputs.future_stillwater_level_m]
description = "Future stillwater level"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.future_design_level_m]
description = "Future stillwater level plus wave allowance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.asset_freeboard_margin_m]
description = "Asset elevation minus future design level and freeboard"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.service_threshold_exceedance_m]
description = "Future stillwater level exceedance over service threshold"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.adaptation_raise_required_m]
description = "Asset raising required to meet future design level and freeboard"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.adaptation_cost_margin_usd]
description = "Adaptation budget minus selected adaptation cost"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.benefit_cost_ratio]
description = "Avoided damage divided by selected adaptation cost"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.scenario_trace_score]
description = "Traced scenarios divided by required scenarios"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when asset review checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001
